actions.create_company.description: Creates a new company record in Twenty CRM.
actions.create_contact.description: Creates a new person record in your Twenty CRM workspace.
actions.create_opportunity.description: Creates a new opportunity (deal) in Twenty CRM.
The monetary value of the deal.
actions.create_opportunity.props.company: The ID of the company associated with this opportunity.
actions.create_opportunity.props.currenc: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).
actions.create_opportunity.props.stage.d: The current stage of the opportunity.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_company.description: Searches for company records in Twenty CRM.
actions.find_person.description: Searches for person records in Twenty CRM.
actions.twenty_create_record.description: Creates one record of any object.
actions.twenty_create_record.props.objec: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_create_record.props.recor: Field values as a JSON object keyed by field name. Composite fields are objects, e.g. {"name": {"firstName": "Ada", "lastName": "Lovelace"}, "emails": {"primaryEmail": "ada@example.com"}, "domainName": {"primaryLinkUrl": "https://acme.com"}, "amount": {"amountMicros": 5000000000, "currencyCode": "USD"}}. Relations take the related record's id, e.g. {"companyId": "<uuid>"}. Use Get Object to see field names and types.
actions.twenty_create_record.props.upser: Update the existing record instead of creating a duplicate when a unique field (e.g. email, domain) already matches. Defaults to false.
actions.twenty_create_records.descriptio: Creates up to 60 records of one object in a single call.
actions.twenty_create_records.props.obje: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_create_records.props.reco: Array of 1-60 JSON objects of field values, e.g. [{"name": "Acme"}, {"name": "Globex"}].
actions.twenty_create_records.props.upse: Update existing records instead of creating duplicates when a unique field already matches. Defaults to false.
actions.twenty_delete_record.description: Deletes one record of any object, softly by default.
actions.twenty_delete_record.props.objec: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_delete_record.props.perma: Permanently destroy the record instead of moving it to the trash. Cannot be undone. Defaults to false.
actions.twenty_delete_record.props.recor: UUID of the record, from List Records, Create Record or Get Record (the `id` field).
actions.twenty_find_duplicate_records.de: Finds likely duplicates of existing records or of candidate record data.
actions.twenty_find_duplicate_records.pr: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
UUIDs of existing records to check for duplicates, from List Records. Leave empty when passing Records.
Candidate records to check before creating them, as JSON objects of field values, e.g. [{"emails": {"primaryEmail": "ada@example.com"}}]. Leave empty when passing Record IDs.
actions.twenty_get_object.description: Gets one object definition with its fields.
actions.twenty_get_object.props.objectId: UUID of the object (the `id` field), from List Objects. Not the object name.
actions.twenty_get_record.description: Gets one record of any object by its id.
actions.twenty_get_record.props.depth.de: Relation depth: 0 returns only the record's own fields (relations as ids), 1 also embeds directly related records. Defaults to 0.
actions.twenty_get_record.props.fields.d: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. "id,name,emails,companyId". `id` is always returned. Omit to return every field.
actions.twenty_get_record.props.objectNa: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_get_record.props.recordId: UUID of the record, from List Records, Create Record or Get Record (the `id` field).
actions.twenty_group_records.description: Groups records by fields and computes aggregates per group.
actions.twenty_group_records.props.aggre: Aggregate names to compute per group, e.g. ["countNotEmptyId"] for a count, ["sumAmountAmountMicros"] or ["maxCreatedAt"]. Pattern: count/countEmpty/countNotEmpty/countUniqueValues/percentageEmpty/min/max/avg/sum + capitalised field name. Omit to get only the group values, without counts.
actions.twenty_group_records.props.filte: Twenty filter expression: field[comparator]:value, comma-separated for AND, or and(...), or(...), not(...). Comparators: eq, neq, in, containsAny, is (NULL / NOT_NULL), gt, gte, lt, lte, startsWith, endsWith, like, ilike (% wildcard). Composite fields use dot paths. Examples: emails.primaryEmail[eq]:"ada@example.com", name.firstName[eq]:"Ada", domainName.primaryLinkUrl[ilike]:"%acme%", stage[in]:["MEETING","PROPOSAL"], createdAt[gte]:"2026-01-01". Use deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL to find soft-deleted records.
actions.twenty_group_records.props.group: Fields to group by, as an array of JSON objects, e.g. [{"stage": true}], [{"address": {"addressCity": true}}] for a composite sub-field, or [{"createdAt": {"granularity": "MONTH"}}] for dates (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR).
actions.twenty_group_records.props.limit: Maximum number of groups to return. Defaults to 50.
actions.twenty_group_records.props.objec: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_group_records.props.order: Order of the groups, as a JSON array, e.g. [{"stage": "AscNullsLast"}] or [{"aggregate": {"countNotEmptyId": "DescNullsLast"}}].
actions.twenty_list_fields.description: Lists field definitions across all objects in the workspace.
actions.twenty_list_fields.props.limit.d: Maximum number of fields to return.
actions.twenty_list_fields.props.startin: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.
actions.twenty_list_objects.description: Lists the standard and custom objects in the workspace.
Maximum number of objects to return.
actions.twenty_list_objects.props.starti: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.
actions.twenty_list_records.description: Lists or searches records of any object, with filter, sort and cursor paging.
Relation depth: 0 returns only the record's own fields (relations as ids), 1 also embeds directly related records. Defaults to 0.
actions.twenty_list_records.props.fields: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. "id,name,emails,companyId". `id` is always returned. Omit to return every field.
actions.twenty_list_records.props.filter: Twenty filter expression: field[comparator]:value, comma-separated for AND, or and(...), or(...), not(...). Comparators: eq, neq, in, containsAny, is (NULL / NOT_NULL), gt, gte, lt, lte, startsWith, endsWith, like, ilike (% wildcard). Composite fields use dot paths. Examples: emails.primaryEmail[eq]:"ada@example.com", name.firstName[eq]:"Ada", domainName.primaryLinkUrl[ilike]:"%acme%", stage[in]:["MEETING","PROPOSAL"], createdAt[gte]:"2026-01-01". Use deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL to find soft-deleted records.
Maximum number of items to return (1-200). Defaults to 60.
actions.twenty_list_records.props.object: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_list_records.props.orderB: Sort expression: field[direction], comma-separated. Directions: AscNullsFirst, AscNullsLast, DescNullsFirst, DescNullsLast. Example: createdAt[DescNullsLast].
actions.twenty_list_records.props.starti: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.
actions.twenty_merge_records.description: Merges 2 to 9 duplicate records of one object into one.
actions.twenty_merge_records.props.confl: Zero-based position in Record IDs of the record whose values win when fields conflict, e.g. 0 for the first id.
actions.twenty_merge_records.props.dryRu: Preview the merged record without changing anything. Defaults to false.
actions.twenty_merge_records.props.objec: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_merge_records.props.recor: UUIDs of the 2-9 records to merge, from List Records or Find Duplicate Records.
actions.twenty_restore_record.props.obje: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_restore_record.props.reco: UUID of the soft-deleted record, from List Records with the filter deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL.
actions.twenty_update_record.description: Updates fields on one record of any object.
actions.twenty_update_record.props.objec: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
actions.twenty_update_record.props.recor: Fields to change, as a JSON object keyed by field name (same format as Create Record), e.g. {"stage": "PROPOSAL"} or {"jobTitle": null} to clear a field.
UUID of the record, from List Records, Create Record or Get Record (the `id` field).
actions.update_company.description: Updates an existing company record in Twenty CRM.
actions.update_company.props.companyId.d: The ID of the company to update. Use the "Find Company" action to look this up.
actions.update_person.description: Updates an existing person record in Twenty CRM.
actions.update_person.props.personId.des: The ID of the person to update. Use the "Find Person" action to look this up.
auth.description:
Connect to your Twenty CRM instance.

1. Log in to your Twenty workspace.
2. Go to **Settings** → **APIs & Webhooks**.
3. Click **+ Create API key**, give it a name (e.g. "Activepieces"), and copy the generated key.
auth.props.base_url.description: The URL of your Twenty instance (e.g. https://app.twenty.com).
triggers.new_company.description: Triggers when a new company is created in Twenty CRM.
triggers.new_person.description: Triggers when a new person is created in Twenty CRM.
